cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Drop the Armor
cards.instruction: Persuade someone to lower their guard, stop performing strength, or admit what affects them.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I left my television on like you. Sounds like we've both got a houseful. But what's hard about going home tonight?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The silence. I leave it on so I can pretend someone else is there.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes, company in the background. Could you ask me over instead of telling me you're managing?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll cook. I promise I won't be miserable all evening.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Invite me without that promise. I'd like to come even if you're miserable and we eat toast.

reason: Replace detachable Stance phrases with particular copied cues and corrections, making A adapt the exact Drive while B pursues a plausible immediate concern.
